title: REQ · Actions and dialogue choices update the story
summary: Choosing an action or dialogue choice updates the story panel history and dialogue
description: Context: useGame.act and useGame.choose update state, which StoryPanel renders via getActiveNode and history. Desired behavior: the dialogue section is a named region so tests can assert it closes after a choice. Expected result: Search adds the hidden door text; choosing a dialogue option closes the dialogue and records it. Why: core story loop.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Bookshelf menu, when Search is clicked, then the Story history list contains 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.'
Given the opening dialogue, when 'Look around the room' is clicked, then the Dialogue region disappears and history contains that text
definition_of_done: Dialogue section exposes accessible name Dialogue
